May 2025 was a landmark month for @BuildOnViction, full of integrations, ecosystem growth, token launches, and global expansion.

Here’s a full breakdown of what went down on one of the fastest-growing EVM chains in Web3 🧵👇

-Key Integrations

Viction deepened its utility with two major partnerships:
• @Starbase_HQ: Users can now buy Telegram Stars with $VIC & $C98.
• @Goldskyxyz: Brings dev-grade indexing, subgraphs & mirror nodes to Viction—powering more robust dApps.

- Ecosystem Wins

• Vikto Bot Launch: $VIKTO launched on Starship with 7,000+ users in 10 days.
• $CARROT Goes Live: A meme coin + contest on RabbitSwap lit up the community.
• NFT Creator Contest: $2,500 prize pool to support artists building on Viction.

- Product Updates

• RabbitSwap released a full portfolio dashboard.
Now users can track token balances, liquidity, net worth, and more, all in one clean UI.

- On-Chain Performance

• 139.7K Monthly Active Wallets
• $11.7M TVL across DeFi protocols
• RabbitSwap hit $12.8M in cumulative volume & $2.2M in TVL
(Sources: Token Terminal, DeFiLlama)

- Governance Milestone:

 VIP#4 Passed 97% of the community voted YES to allocate 5M $VIC to power:
• Core Infrastructure
• Branding & Ops
• Community Expansion
Viction’s growth is being co-driven by its users.

- Global Expansion Begins:

 Viction Philippines 🇵🇭 has launched!

Backed by @coinsph & @Frontier_DAO, this move taps into SEA’s fast-growing Web3 base. Expect events, local dev support, and real community building.

 May was proof that Viction is more than hype. f you’re a builder, creator, or user looking for zero-gas, fast-finality, and real ecosystem support, watch @VictionEco  closely.

More info: https://t.co/KjXdyugnDW

May was big. The second half of 2025 will be even bigger. 💥
